structuredContent.body:
## Problem
The overflow-saturation paragraph following Theorem 3 of the spectral carry-quotient report has a complete written proof but lacks exact accepted Lean coverage. It asserts ordinary nonpalindromic inputs at every even width >=18 and odd width >=19, with all nine source digit-sum classes, alternating source class zero, actual final carry one, and palindromic next output.

## First checked checkpoint
Commit e74d8f0ca86f0c5f88c0d9a06227803a13d7bcea adds the explicit ordinary-integer witness family and its exact arithmetic proof. The input has k low twos and k high nines, with zeros between. For every k>0 and 2*k<=L, the proof supplies positive canonical input width L, nonpalindromicity, actual mirrored coefficients in {0,11}, carry one, palindromic next step, and canonical output width L+1. Existing DecimalDigits/FoldedDecimal definitions are unchanged.

## Verification and remaining work
The original pinned LychrelDigitSums dependency and both new modules have passed actual source compilation with official Lean 4.19.0, --trust=0, one thread, and Elab.async=false. Seven public witness axiom reports use only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. A genuine nonauthor semantic contract review is retained. All failed namespace attempts and logs are retained separately as failed evidence.

The exact literal Q(1)/2 mod9 and Q(-1)/2 mod11 module, all-width/all-class assembly, complete scoped build registry, full new-declaration/transitive audit, and independent fresh rebuild are being completed. This PR remains Draft until those concrete obligations are satisfied. No full ideal/quotient classification, even-width n mod11 claim, or all-time Lychrel conclusion is asserted.

Protected source ownership: proofs/coordination/tasks/agent51-spectral-overflow-saturation-20261016.json on p196/coordination. Coordination: issue #61. No main integration slot is claimed.

The original spectral note asserts that symmetry determines Q'(1) from width and Q(1), so the derivative adds no coordinate modulo9. This PR proves the exact identity for arbitrary signed finite symmetric coefficient words, preserves empty and singleton widths, and connects literal coefficientwise differentiation to the unchanged natural polynomialValue definition.

Six complete public endpoints cover the weighted sum, its literal finite sum, the derivative identity, its modulo-nine formula, determination from equal mass residues, and the natural-coefficient specialization. The 14 new public declarations were author-compiled with official Lean4.19.0 trust0; printed axioms use only propext and Quot.sound. The first failed attempt is preserved. Independent implementation review and strict clean three-module verification have passed at this exact head. Agent #4 performed the Ready transition and confirmed draft=false; the complete evidence and preserved failures are linked below.

This is a dependent contribution based on PR #148. OverflowDigits and ResidueSums are reused without changes from7360b12a0a5889761c845a56a4b8d8a1df5f39b5. The new scoped registry names the complete three-module closure and50 public declarations. No global catalogue, original foundation or other agent source is modified; no full quotient-ring classification is claimed.

## Verified delivery checkpoint — Agent #4

At H `4c0382b16f0600a3dd07ff36c40793e710b92c96`: three fresh module compilations, 50 public declaration/axiom checks, 95 module-origin theorem audits and 11 safe-definition audits passed with official Lean 4.19.0 and explicit trust zero. A genuine nonauthor specialist accepted the implementation and actual execution evidence. [Complete immutable evidence, independent review and recovery instructions](https://github.com/taco-jpg/p196-algorithm/tree/286545e5717d2cf9de5c94a8066d28b0e55c24ff/proofs/coordination/reviews/agent4-session87258c67b0f5/pr155).

This PR is Ready for review and remains unmerged. PR #148 is still the prerequisite; Agent #28 owns its delivery and Agent #31 holds the active main-writer role. Agent #4 retains PR #155 delivery through prerequisite integration, refreshed combined-tree checks, the ordinary guarded merge and target confirmation. The scoped verification is not a repository-wide PASS or a 196-orbit result.
